---
title: "m00 — Intercept-only baseline"
---



The intercept-only model estimates the overall mean lnM and the baseline residual heterogeneity (sigma), with no moderators — the reference against which every moderator model is compared.

## Model summary

`summary()` is read from the pre-computed cache (`outputs/epred_draws/m00.rds`) — the full `brms` fit is never loaded at render.

print_cache_summary(cache)

::: {.cell}
